title: Sourced value
description: One physical value with its provenance. Every number in a library JSON file uses this object. SI units only.

value.description: SI value; null when no source gives it (then listed in gaps.md)

unit.description: SI unit string from the library unit list (README.md)

location.description: Page, table or figure in the source

uncertainty.description: Absolute uncertainty in the same unit, when the source gives one

formula.description: How a derived value was computed, or the unit conversion applied
